mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TODO WHERE TODO_ID = #{todoId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TODO (TODO_ID, EMPNO, CONTENT, IS_DONE, PRIORITY, DUE_DATE, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{empno}, #{content}, 0, #{priority, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dueDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{sortOrder}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TODO SET CONTENT = #{content}, PRIORITY = #{priority, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate, jdbcType=DATE}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TODO_ID = #{todoId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}
UPDATE TODO SET IS_DONE = CASE WHEN IS_DONE = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TODO_ID = #{todoId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}
UPDATE TODO SET SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder} WHERE TODO_ID = #{todoId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TODO WHERE TODO_ID = #{todoId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}
